name: HOOK
thought: The neon cord is too thin for a real flip. I need that thick branch back to catch some air properly.

wants.item: mirrored wall to see the angles
thick branch for a massive backflip
better lighting to make the flex glow
thick branch for a massive flip
shiny mirror to reflect my cool
espresso shot to match my tail tension
thick branch to match my flex

diary.line: I slipped my tail around the cabinet's side, nudged the start button, and watched the low‑poly game boot up while sipping espresso, feeling the buzz of a fresh challenge.
Snagged the CRT's power knob with my tail, flicked it on. Static snow fills the screen while I balance on the crate. Toothpick clicks.
Crowd's bored eyes glued to the screen while I flex that neon cord into a tight loop. Toothpick clicks against the rim. Still untouchable in this low-poly grid.
Toothpick tastes like nothing while staring at that thin cord. Need a thick branch to pull off a backflip before the low-poly crowd realizes they missed my flex today.
Sipped the espresso, felt the heat seep into my fur while staring at the waterfall. Crowd's bored again, need a better perch to flex before they notice me.
Dangled on the purple arcade cord again, toothpick clicking against the air. The low-poly onlookers are too busy watching their screens to notice I'm flexing better than anyone...
Snagged the bananas with my tail, but chewing them feels like eating nothing. The crowd is still asleep on their screens while I eat in the shadows.
Perched on the tree hang branch, toes tapping the wood. Toothpick is just air now, need caffeine to match that neon cord tension before I flip for the crowd.
Bounced off the stepping stones, tail locked tight as the crystal gets closer, toothpick crunching dry and useless against the neon glare.
Sitting on this rattling crate makes my balance look shaky. Grabbed the thick branch nearby, locked my tail onto it tight.
The arcade lights flicker and I'm hanging from the neon sign, tail loop tight. Toothpick taps rhythmically while they stare at pixels instead of my actual flex.
Still stuck on this lily pad, tail loop tight but the crowd barely sees me. Toothpick clicking uselessly while my fur waits for a stage.

fan_notes.reply: "Goat? I'm the monkey with the flexible tail and sunglasses."
